label: Show the standalone Boost card
description: On by default in a standalone Boost install. Turn it off to hide the Boost-owned card; the Widgets tray still owns the single Boost card when it is installed. Does not add a second card to the full pack.

label: Free memory once after startup, when the browser has been quiet for 90 seconds
Unloading may include pinned and Essential tabs
description: Off by default: they restore on demand like any tab, but they are your shortlist. Turn this on to let a deep pass include them. Renamed from keep_pinned in 3.4.0; an existing 'on' choice is carried over once.

label: Keyboard shortcut for Free memory (light)
description: For example Accel+Shift+B. Empty means no shortcut.

label: Keep browser RAM under a limit
description: Off by default. When on, Boost watches the total and acts only when it crosses the limit below.

label: RAM limit (MB, total for all browser processes) [0 to 65536]
What happens at the limit
description: Soft only tells you; hard unloads tabs and panels the tab policy allows, three at a time, until the target is met.

options.label: Hard — unload what the policy allows

label: Stop a hard run at this share of the limit (%) [0 to 100]
Game Mode: pause everything else while I play
description: Level 3 of Memory Boost. Runs ONE plan-driven unload pass through the panel sleep door, then a light clean after the settle and one late clean about 30 s later. Pauses repeating timers (widgets, video discovery, RSS, Notes) and stops painting tabs you are not looking at. Audible tabs, the video preview source, sharing/PiP/private/add-on host tabs and configured keep-hosts stay loaded. Unloaded tabs lose unsaved page state and need a short reload when you return; Restore is available. Off when the browser restarts.

label: Stronger saver: also sleep apps marked 'keep running'
description: Off by default. OUTSIDE Game Mode, this opens every Essential-panel background mode (including live/keep running) to a manual Level 2 deep pass. Game Mode does not depend on it; a plain deep pass still sleeps only asleep-allowed records.

label: Game Mode: sites that must stay loaded (host names, comma-separated)
description: Optional. A tab whose host matches one of these names is kept, for example music.example.com, bank.example.com. Empty keeps nothing extra.

label: Game Mode: park the selected tab so it can be unloaded too
description: On by default. Game Mode creates one temporary about:blank parking tab, selects it from a deferred task, then unloads the original. Turn this off to keep the old behavior where the selected tab always stays loaded.

label: Game Mode: what Restore brings back
description: All tabs, the most recent tabs, panels only, or nothing. Panels are woken first; tabs reload in the background without changing selection. Unloaded pages lose unsaved form state and need a short reload.

label: Game Mode: number of recent tabs to restore [0 to 500]
Game Mode: delay between restore items (ms) [0 to 60000]
Game Mode: Restore when the mode is switched off
description: Ask shows the Restore action; always runs Restore automatically; never leaves the snapshot for a manual Restore. This is the kill switch for automatic restore on exit.
